comments.body:
This can be nice pirate ship including fast sail and 9 mod.

So I will tip for having this ship.
it has hidden skills.
1.Modified Heavy Gun Port+Mast top+Control tower= Direct hit prevention
2.Modified Heavy Gun Port+Mast top+Traverse rope= Pre-emptive attack
you can also get Assault Deck Battle, Rowing Assistance, Training bomb, Set fire.
